0362__L7_DRI_90__FC264310.mp3.asr_text: You got him! Damn, that was beautiful.

0363__L7_COM_91__EAA24FEB.mp3.asr_text: Bag yourself your first tiger, soldier. Nice work, kid.
0363__L7_COM_91__EAA24FEB.mp3.translation: 小子，你第一辆虎式到手了，干得好！

0364__L7_DRI_21__F0426E38.mp3.asr_text: Some rough terrain. Nothing this baby can't handle though.
0364__L7_DRI_21__F0426E38.mp3.translation: 不好走，不过这宝贝什么路都能开。

0365__L7_COM_56__E41562F4.mp3.asr_text: Got it! Now find the other one and ace it the same way!
0365__L7_COM_56__E41562F4.mp3.translation: 干掉了！找到另一辆，照样收拾！

0368__L7_COM_66__E5CA3B93.mp3.asr_text: Command tanks destroyed! Hell, the Krauts got a damn Tiger tank dug into that building over there!
0368__L7_COM_66__E5CA3B93.mp3.translation: 指挥坦克被击毁了！妈的，德国佬在那栋楼里藏了辆虎式！

0369__L7_DRI_67__F76A5DBA.mp3.asr_text: That's it then! We try crossing that bridge to get within range of even scratching it from a frontal attack, and we're gonna get picked off like crows sitting on a telephone wire!
0369__L7_DRI_67__F76A5DBA.mp3.translation: 这下完了！要过桥靠近，才能从正面给它蹭掉点皮。可到那时候，咱们早被当成电线上排排坐的乌鸦，一个个打掉了！

0370__L7_COM_60__E575AE8D.mp3.asr_text: It's gone. Road's clear ahead. Let's get rolling.
0370__L7_COM_60__E575AE8D.mp3.translation: 干掉了，前面的路通了，走！

0371__L7_OTH_157__A478967E.mp3.asr_text: Flak 88s, anti-tank guns, hidden in the tree line. Move forward and protect our infantry from any Jerry soldiers as they take out those damn guns!
0371__L7_OTH_157__A478967E.mp3.translation: 树林边藏着八八反坦克炮！往前开，挡住德国步兵，掩护咱们的人端掉那些炮！

0373__L7_UNI_8__2012BCF0.mp3.asr_text: Okay, Halt! I'm batting down the hatches! Air Force are coming in now!
0373__L7_UNI_8__2012BCF0.mp3.translation: 好，停车！关好舱盖，空军马上就到！
0373__L7_UNI_8__2012BCF0.mp3.note: batting down疑似battening down，按关闭舱盖处理。

0374__L7_DRI_23__F05E9D3A.mp3.asr_text: Lotta crop positions in those fields. They're dug in real good, too.
0374__L7_DRI_23__F05E9D3A.mp3.translation: 田里全是德军阵地，工事也挖得够深。
0374__L7_DRI_23__F05E9D3A.mp3.note: crop positions疑似Kraut positions；AM可佐证，仅修正误词，不改写台词。

0375__L7_COM_24__DEDAAA15.mp3.asr_text: And we'll just have to dig him back out again! Nothing this baby can't handle, remember?
0375__L7_COM_24__DEDAAA15.mp3.translation: 那就把他们挖出来！不是说这宝贝啥都能对付吗？

0376__L7_DRI_34__F2218D5A.mp3.asr_text: Got it! Fine shooting there, pal!

0378__L7_COM_44__E2445B53.mp3.asr_text: Oh, hell! More of them in the tree line ahead!

0380__L7_DRI_45__F3E47D7A.mp3.asr_text: We got two of our guys!
0380__L7_DRI_45__F3E47D7A.mp3.note: ASR主语We got疑似They got，结合坦克战损失语境拟译，数量按ASR保留，待听音。

0381__L7_COM_125__C46C71FD.mp3.asr_text: IT'S NOT ENOUGH! WE'RE SURROUNDED! GET US THE HELL OUTTA HERE!
0381__L7_COM_125__C46C71FD.mp3.translation: 不行！我们被包围了！快开出去！

0382__L7_COM_36__E0ABB1B6.mp3.asr_text: On our right, traverse turret and fire!

0383__L7_COM_70__E72A872C.mp3.asr_text: Enemy tanks on the far riverbank! You got any spare rounds left, you know where to put them!
0383__L7_COM_70__E72A872C.mp3.translation: 对岸有敌军坦克！还有炮弹的话，知道该往哪儿送了吧！

0384__L7_COM_71__E7389EAD.mp3.asr_text: Blast that enemy armor, soldier! If we don't knock him out now, we'll be meeting him much closer up when we get across that river!
0384__L7_COM_71__E7389EAD.mp3.translation: 开炮打那些坦克！现在不干掉它们，过了河就要贴着脸打了！

0385__L7_COM_61__E583C60E.mp3.asr_text: Take it easy. Watch those woods for ambush points.
0385__L7_COM_61__E583C60E.mp3.translation: 慢点，留意树林，小心埋伏。

0386__L7_OTH_116__9D971C81.mp3.asr_text: Thanks for that, boys! We got it! Move out!
0386__L7_OTH_116__9D971C81.mp3.translation: 谢了，弟兄们！这儿拿下了，出发！

0387__L7_COM_104__C0F4A93E.mp3.asr_text: Finish off any remaining Jerrys, men!

0388__L7_COM_19__DD6C46FB.mp3.asr_text: Hose him with the MG! That's what it's there for!
0388__L7_COM_19__DD6C46FB.mp3.translation: 用机枪扫！不然装它干什么！

0389__L7_COM_20__DEA24C11.mp3.asr_text: We'll take it down the other side of the ridge and meet up with the rest of our guys. Watch out for any stray krauts.
0389__L7_COM_20__DEA24C11.mp3.translation: 从山脊另一边下去，跟大部队会合。留意散兵。

0390__L7_DRI_9__E71A28DC.mp3.asr_text: Here they come! Ha! Look at that! Crowds don't know what hit them!
0390__L7_DRI_9__E71A28DC.mp3.translation: 他们来了！哈！瞧瞧，德国佬都不知道怎么回事！

0391__L7_COM_103__C0E691BD.mp3.asr_text: Thanks boys, we'll finish off the rest. Fourth and 80th, move out at full speed.
0391__L7_COM_103__C0E691BD.mp3.translation: 谢了，剩下的交给我们。四师、八十师，全速前进！

0392__L7_OTH_149__A2DFECE1.mp3.translation: 格雷森的坦克刚被打掉了！

0395__L7_UNI_46__DBC15C06.mp3.asr_text: Incoming from those woods! All units, pull back!
0395__L7_UNI_46__DBC15C06.mp3.translation: 树林里有炮火！所有部队后撤！

0397__L7_COM_41__E21A14D0.mp3.asr_text: That's it! Last one taken care of! Nice firing, son!
0397__L7_COM_41__E21A14D0.mp3.translation: 成了，最后一个也干掉了！小子，打得漂亮！

0398__L7_COM_81__E8ED774C.mp3.asr_text: Keep it up with those shells, soldier!

0400__L7_COM_11__DCFB8AF3.mp3.asr_text: Still some German guns in action up top of that ridge. We're breaking off to engage.
0400__L7_COM_11__DCFB8AF3.mp3.translation: 山脊上还有德军火炮在开火，我们脱离队列去收拾。

0401__L7_COM_28__DF130819.mp3.asr_text: Another one! They're on our flanks!

0402__L7_COM_75__E770FCB1.mp3.asr_text: Okay, we're across! Let's find that hidden tank and get that bridge secured!
0402__L7_COM_75__E770FCB1.mp3.translation: 过来了！找出那辆藏着的坦克，把桥拿下！

0404__L7_DRI_74__F8F4EFD6.mp3.asr_text: Oh man, oh man, oh man, oh man, oh man, oh man.

0405__L7_DRI_62__F723E835.mp3.asr_text: Watch for German infantry! Give it to them, cowboy!
0405__L7_DRI_62__F723E835.mp3.translation: 留意德国步兵！小伙子，给我狠狠地打！

0406__L7_OTH_158__A486ADFF.mp3.asr_text: That's how you do it in my town, boys. Ha ha! Move on out!
0406__L7_OTH_158__A486ADFF.mp3.translation: 我们那儿就是这么打仗的，弟兄们！哈哈！继续走！

0407__L7_COM_92__EAB0676C.mp3.asr_text: Roads clear. Let's move on out to Bastogne. Gonna be a merry Christmas after all for our boys there.
0407__L7_COM_92__EAB0676C.mp3.translation: 路通了，开往巴斯托涅。那儿的弟兄们总算能过个好圣诞了。

0408__L7_DRI_113__E34AB476.mp3.asr_text: What the- Jones just bought it!

0409__L7_COM_1__EE5A643A.mp3.asr_text: Keep in formation and keep moving.

0410__L7_DRI_2__E6B78455.mp3.asr_text: Visibility's lousy with all this snow.

0411__L7_COM_3__EE76933C.mp3.translation: 天晓得那片树林里藏了多少德国鬼子。但咱们只能硬着头皮往前冲，要是赶不到巴斯托涅救出咱们的人，鬼知道德国佬的反扑还会捅出多大篓子
0411__L7_COM_3__EE76933C.mp3.note: ASR因超长跳过。未使用AM旧稿补写，待补识别或听音。

0412__L7_DRI_96__FC7AD016.mp3.asr_text: Damn Jerry's, people here didn't stand a chance!
0412__L7_DRI_96__FC7AD016.mp3.translation: 该死的德国佬！这儿的人根本没处躲！

0413__L7_COM_97__EAF6DCF1.mp3.asr_text: That's why we're here, soldier. To kick Jerry where it hurts.
0413__L7_COM_97__EAF6DCF1.mp3.translation: 所以我们才来这儿，小子。专挑德国佬的痛处打。

0414__L7_UNI_29__D881F14B.mp3.asr_text: German panzers on our right and left flanks. Units on those flanks, peel off and engage.
0414__L7_UNI_29__D881F14B.mp3.translation: 左右两翼发现德军坦克！两翼部队脱离队列，接敌！

0415__L7_COM_30__E05724B0.mp3.asr_text: That's us! Move right and engage! Damn, Krauts are trying to catch us in a pincer movement!
0415__L7_COM_30__E05724B0.mp3.translation: 说咱们呢！向右，接敌！妈的，德国佬想两面夹击！

0416__L7_DRI_112__E33C9CF5.mp3.asr_text: WATCH YOURSELF, THEY HAVE PANZER SHREKTS!
0416__L7_DRI_112__E33C9CF5.mp3.translation: 小心！他们有反坦克火箭筒！
0416__L7_DRI_112__E33C9CF5.mp3.note: Panzer Shrekts疑似Panzerschrecks，按反坦克火箭筒翻译。

0418__L7_DRI_42__F3BA36F7.mp3.asr_text: Taking us back around to rejoin formation!

0420__L7_DRI_76__F9111ED8.mp3.asr_text: Here come those tanks! Told you we should have blasted them when we had the chance!
0420__L7_DRI_76__F9111ED8.mp3.translation: 那些坦克来了！早说能打的时候就该干掉它们！

0421__L7_COM_78__E79B4334.mp3.asr_text: Keep your eyes open! You just know that Tiger's gonna have its units in place to cover its ass end!
0421__L7_COM_78__E79B4334.mp3.translation: 都盯紧点！那辆虎式肯定安排了人护着屁股！

0422__L7_UNI_63__DF00C6C1.mp3.asr_text: Bridge ahead! We'll have to cross single file only! Command is taking point! Cover me!
0422__L7_UNI_63__DF00C6C1.mp3.translation: 前面有桥！只能单列通过！指挥车先走，掩护我！

0423__L7_DRI_64__F7401737.mp3.asr_text: Oh man, I got a bad feeling about this one.
0423__L7_DRI_64__F7401737.mp3.translation: 这下可不妙，我有种不好的预感。

0424__L7_COM_58__E43191F6.mp3.asr_text: That's it! The 80th can clear the tree line now it- Oh, hell!
0424__L7_COM_58__E43191F6.mp3.translation: 好了！八十师现在能清理树林了……干！

0425__L7_DRI_59__F5D1B41D.mp3.asr_text: Panzer! Panzer coming out of those woods!
0425__L7_DRI_59__F5D1B41D.mp3.translation: 坦克！树林里开出来一辆坦克！

0426__L7_DRI_27__F096FB3E.mp3.asr_text: THEY GOT ONE OF OUR GUYS!

0427__L7_DRI_5__E6E1CAD8.mp3.asr_text: Our lead Shermans are taking fire from German guns up on that ridge. Aren't we going to return fire?
0427__L7_DRI_5__E6E1CAD8.mp3.translation: 前面的谢尔曼坦克正在被山脊的德军攻击，我们不还击吗？

0428__L7_COM_6__EEA0D9BF.mp3.asr_text: We keep going. Someone else is going to take care of that.
0428__L7_COM_6__EEA0D9BF.mp3.translation: 继续开，会有人收拾他们。

0429__L7_UNI_7__2004A56F.mp3.asr_text: All tanks, prepare to stop on my command. We've got air support coming in to clear that ridge.
0429__L7_UNI_7__2004A56F.mp3.translation: 所有坦克，听我命令停车。空中支援要来清理那道山脊。

0430__L7_COM_129__C4A4D001.mp3.asr_text: MORE OF THEM TO THE NORTH!

0432__L7_DRI_48__F40EC3FD.mp3.asr_text: We got crowd infantry advancing out of that tree line!
0432__L7_DRI_48__F40EC3FD.mp3.translation: 德国步兵正从树林边冲出来！
0432__L7_DRI_48__F40EC3FD.mp3.note: crowd infantry疑似Kraut infantry，按德国步兵翻译。
